review.assessment: This change introduces `expo/paging.py` with a `pages()` function that slices rows into fixed-size chunks using integer division (`len(rows) // size`). Because it only iterates up to the number of full pages, any remainder rows (in this case, 7 out of 47) are silently dropped. This directly reproduces and causes the nightly export audit failure where `RowCountMismatch` reports 40 rows instead of 47.

findings.call: python -c "from expo.paging import pages; out = pages(list(range(47))); print(len(out), sum(map(len, out)))"
findings.defect: Paging discards remainder rows causing RowCountMismatch
